lines.en: Lesson 2
lines.zh: 第2课

lines.en: Thirteen equals one
lines.zh: 十三等于一

lines.en: Was the vicar pleased that the clock was striking? Why?
lines.zh: 牧师对钟声响起感到高兴吗？为什么？

lines.en: Our vicar is always raising money for one cause or another,
lines.zh: 我们的牧师总是为这样或那样的缘故筹款，

lines.en: but he has never managed to get enough money to have the church clock repaired.
lines.zh: 但他从未筹集到足够的钱来修理教堂的时钟。

lines.en: The big clock which used to strike the hours day and night was damaged many years ago and has been silent ever since.
lines.zh: 那座日夜报时的大钟多年前损坏了，从那以后就一直沉默不语。

lines.en: One night, however, our vicar woke up with a start:the clock was striking the hours!
lines.zh: 然而，一天晚上，我们的牧师突然惊醒：钟正在报时！

lines.en: Looking at his watch, he saw that it was one o'clock,
lines.zh: 他看了看表，发现是一点钟，

lines.en: but the bell struck thirteen times before it stopped.
lines.zh: 但钟声响了十三次才停下来。

lines.en: Armed with a torch, the vicar went up into the clock tower to see what was going on.
lines.zh: 牧师拿着手电筒，爬上钟楼，想看看发生了什么事。

lines.en: In the torchlight, he caught sight of a figure whom he immediately recognized as Bill Wilkins, our local grocer.
lines.zh: 在手电筒的光束中，他看到一个人影，他立刻认出那是比尔·威尔金斯，我们当地的杂货商。

lines.en: 'Whatever are you doing up here Bill?' asked the vicar in surprise.
lines.zh: “比尔，你在这上面做什么？”牧师惊讶地问道。

lines.en: 'I'm trying to repair the bell, ' answered Bill.
lines.zh: “我正在努力修理钟，”比尔回答道。

lines.en: 'I've been coming up here night after night for weeks now.
lines.zh: “我来这里已经好几个星期了，夜复一夜。

lines.en: You see, I was hoping to give you a surprise.'
lines.zh: 你看，我本来希望能给你一个惊喜。”

lines.en: 'You certainly did give me a surprise!' said the vicar.
lines.zh: “你确实给了我一个惊喜！”牧师说。

lines.en: 'You've probably woken up everyone in the village as well.
lines.zh: “你可能也把村里所有人都吵醒了。

lines.en: Still, I'm glad the bell is working again.'
lines.zh: 不过，我很高兴钟又响了。”

lines.en: 'That's the trouble, vicar, 'answered Bill. 'It's working all right,
lines.zh: “问题就在这儿，牧师，”比尔回答道。“它确实在响，

lines.en: but I'm afraid that at one o'clock it will strike thirteen times and there's nothing I can do about it.'
lines.zh: 但我担心一点钟的时候它会响十三次，我对此束手无策。”

lines.en: 'We'll get used to that, Bill, 'said the vicar.
lines.zh: “我们会习惯的，比尔，”牧师说。

lines.en: 'Thirteen is not as good as one, but it's better than nothing.
lines.zh: “十三次不如一次好，但总比没有好。

lines.en: Now let's go downstairs and have a cup of tea.'
lines.zh: 现在我们下去喝杯茶吧。”
